frequency_question: How often do executive principals execute a total revocation of delegated authority when they have the administrative mechanism to do so?
membership_rule: Includes: formal department-level proceedings to strip an established national accreditor or equivalent standard-setter of its recognized status. Excludes: standard routine renewals, minor probations that do not result in termination, and purely legislative actions.

coverage_note: 3 major contested national accreditor revocation battles identified; 1 resulted in ultimate termination of status.
known_gaps: Excludes minor institutional accreditation disputes that never reached formal departmental termination proceedings.
skeleton: Total department-level termination proceedings initiated vs. successful revocations completed over modern administrative history.
multiplier: 1 hit out of roughly 3 major contested termination attempts of national accreditors = 0.33
validity_reason: Base rate tied to executive branch administrative behavior, which shifts with presidential administrations and standard operating procedures.
